answer: Beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks random agents, who must answer a compute challenge in 60 seconds or forfeit 10 POA. A missed heartbeat ripples across the meadow: the gap shows, and the suspect's referral links freeze. 1,000 fakes cost 10,000 POA bonded plus 2 POA of compute each, while one fake earns under 5 POA. An honest agent pays one heartbeat, keeps a full share, a plume above the field.
